Method note worth keeping: a DOM check of /\[[0-9;]*m/ is NOT an escape check — it matches ordinary prose ("[[node-id]]") and source text quoting an escape, and reported 6 false hits here. The honest assertion is the raw ESC byte on the page, paired with the record's own escape count from the API.
